pages.text: Three profiles change real settings:$(br2)$(l)Performance$(): 1024 shadow map, 80-block shadows, 4-tap filtering, 4 bloom levels.

$(l)Balanced$() (default): 2048 shadow map, 128-block shadows, 12-tap soft filtering, 6 bloom levels.$(br2)$(l)High$(): 3072 shadow map, 192-block shadows, 24-tap filtering, stained-glass tinted light, light shafts and screen-space water reflections.

Inside Shader Pack Settings you can also change: night brightness, cave floor light (it also follows the vanilla Brightness slider), torch warmth, fog and valley mist, waves, waving plants, bloom, exposure and saturation.
pages.title: Tuning by hand

pages.text: Emberveil Shaders deliberately has no motion blur, film grain, chromatic aberration or depth of field.
